cds.title: University of Nebraska at Kearney Common Data Set 2025-2026 (PDF; page headers print 2024-2025 but items ask for fall 2025 data)

stats.notes: CDS C1 (fall 2025 entering class). International applicants were admitted at a much lower rate (150 of 253, 59%) than in-state (87.6%) or out-of-state (79.4%) applicants; international enrollees: 28. Only 28 students submitted SAT scores (3%) and 723 submitted ACT (90%), so SAT percentiles rest on a very small sample. No early decision or early action, no waitlist. Undergrad count and intl_undergrads are the B1 totals (4,056 undergraduates, 240 nonresidents). The posted PDF looks like a working copy (placeholder text in the respondent block and 2024-2025 page headers) although its items are for fall 2025.

cds_test_policy.notes: CDS C8A (fall 2027): SAT/ACT 'not required for admission, but considered if submitted'.

cost.notes: CDS G1 first-year figures: in-state tuition $7,320, nonresident tuition $15,990 ($533 x 30 credits), required fees $2,153, food and housing $12,294; G5 books $798. The CDS box says 2026-27 costs were not yet final when it was completed, so the in-state tuition, fees and books may be 2025-26 values; the nonresident rate and housing match the UNK 2026-27 international cost page. CDS H6: only institutional non-need-based aid is available to nonresidents; 63 nonresident undergraduates received it (average $4,301).
